note: The input escape sequence \n inside a JSON member name is decoded into an actual newline character stored in string_buffer_.
The decoded member-name string_view, whose final character is the newline, is delivered to the JSON encoder visitor as a key.
The encoder forwards the key buffer and its exact length to escape_string for re-escaping.
After converting the final control character, it is set to r.ptr, which is already end; the for-loop increment then advances it past end instead of leaving it before end.
The next loop iteration tests only it != end, so the past-end pointer is dereferenced, producing a one-byte container-overflow read.
